items.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin

items.title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
items.summary: The truce was originally planned for the stranded residents of Oleshky, and Russia and Ukraine say no breaches have been reported.

items.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China

items.title: Lula's comeback in Brazil dents Trump's ambitions for Latin America
items.summary: The Trump-Lula relationship may have thawed, but several issues could reignite tensions between the two leaders.

items.title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard
items.summary: The woman began her career at the park when she was 17 and had worked there on-and-off for four decades.

items.title: Ex-wife of Zimbabwe's vice-president freed after collapse of attempted murder case
items.summary: Marry Mubaiwa had been held on remand for seven years after being charged in 2019 for her then husband's attempted murder.
